assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game VFX sprite sheet, not a storyboard. Create ONE eight-frame hand-painted animation sprite sheet for 'Startrail Inspiration', a cute expedition fox's ally attack-speed spell, for a polished fantasy autochess game. EXACT layout: 4 equal columns by 2 equal rows, read left to right then next row, preferably 1536x768 pixels, NO gutters, NO visible grid, NO labels, NO text, NO characters, NO scenery. All eight cels share identical center registration and generous transparent padding (effect contained in central 78% of each cell). Genuine transparent RGBA background throughout. Style: refined painterly 2D fantasy game magic with clean silhouettes, rich gold, warm ivory and turquoise/teal, translucent luminous edges; readable at 100 pixels. Camera: slight isometric, elliptical floor sigil. Animation 1 faint golden compass sparks gathering, 2 compass rose draws itself, 3 teal wind ribbon curls around ring, 4 gold eight-point star blooms with two upward speed chevrons, 5 brightest open compass ring and star motes, 6 ribbon expands outward, 7 ring breaks into drifting gold star fragments, 8 sparse fading motes. Same single coherent compass spell evolving continuously across all 8 frames, no random different symbols. No rectangular haze, no dark/white background, no painted checkerboard, no typography, no watermark. Preserve luminous transparent holes and empty center so the underlying unit stays readable.
